novelty_method: The complete 3650-title chain was reconstructed from the immutable 3530-row Neris proposal index plus the six later twenty-row freezes through Auren v662-v7. Exact and normalized token-neighbor review rejected collisions including COSE, JWS, WebVTT, CBOR, OpenType, JSON canonicalization, STAC-adjacent formats, Vainshtein, entropy-production, calibration-drift and prior railway handover surfaces. Older proposal rows that use description instead of title were included. Selected inherited rows remain zero-credit context.
selection_credit: Twenty Auren rows are selected for boundary revalidation only. They receive zero Sable novelty, execution or completion credit.

new_proposals.title: RDFC-1.0 descriptor and poison-budget reservation
new_proposals.hypothesis: A metadata-only RDF canonicalization descriptor can require the exact RDFC-1.0 algorithm, a supported hash declaration and a finite poison-dataset work budget without accepting or canonicalizing an RDF dataset.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: An unknown algorithm or hash, Boolean or nonpositive budget, embedded dataset, claimed canonical output or claimed signature validity passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only RDFC-1.0 with SHA-256 or SHA-384 and a bounded positive work declaration passes; dataset and output fields are refused.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the descriptor, retain it for review and canonicalize or hash no dataset.

new_proposals.title: SHACL validation-report cardinality and result-shape receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic SHACL validation-report object can enforce one Boolean conforms value and mandatory fields for each declared result without executing a shapes graph.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Conforms is non-Boolean, a conforming report has results, a nonconforming report has none, or a result omits severity, focus node or source constraint component and passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Exact cardinality and mandatory result fields pass while every inconsistent report fails without reading a graph.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the report and execute no SHACL processor.

new_proposals.title: SPARQL JSON result binding closure and ASK-SELECT separation
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded SPARQL results JSON shape can require exactly one ASK Boolean or SELECT bindings surface and ensure every bound variable was declared in the head.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: ASK and SELECT forms coexist, neither exists, variables are duplicated, a binding uses an undeclared variable, or an RDF term lacks required type and value fields and passes.
primary_source_needs: W3C SPARQL 1.1 Query Results JSON Recommendation
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: One bounded ASK or SELECT fixture passes and every undeclared, mixed or malformed binding fails without a query or endpoint.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the result object and issue no query.

new_proposals.title: DCAT distribution access-download and checksum distinction receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic DCAT distribution metadata can distinguish accessURL from direct downloadURL and validate a closed media-type and checksum descriptor without dereferencing either URL.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: No location is declared, a non-HTTPS location passes, media type or checksum shape is malformed, or access and download metadata is promoted to retrievability, licensing or rights truth.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: At least one HTTPS access or download location and bounded descriptor fields pass; malformed or authority-promoting declarations fail.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the descriptor and fetch no resource.

new_proposals.title: OpenPGP one-pass signature nesting and association shape
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic OpenPGP packet-type sequence can enforce one-pass-signature nesting and reverse signature association without parsing bytes, keys or signed content.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A signature lacks a prior one-pass packet, nesting flags are inconsistent, closing signatures are not reversed, or the result is called cryptographic verification.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A bounded nested sequence passes; orphaned, misordered or inconsistent sequences fail with no byte parsing or cryptography.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the sequence and process no key, signature or payload.

new_proposals.title: Server-Sent Events field, identifier and retry-budget tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic Server-Sent Events block can bound line count and bytes while validating data, event, id and retry fields without opening a connection.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Unknown fields are promoted, id contains NUL or newline, retry is negative or non-integer, count or byte budgets are exceeded, or a real stream is opened.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A bounded synthetic event passes and malformed identifiers, retry values or excessive blocks fail before any connection or dispatch.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Drop the synthetic block and open no connection.

new_proposals.title: gRPC status trailer and details-bin shape audit
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic gRPC trailers can require a decimal status in the defined range, bounded percent-encoded message text and optional base64-shaped details without making an RPC.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Status is absent or outside 0 through 16, success carries failure-only details, percent escapes are malformed, details are oversized, or an RPC result is claimed.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Bounded synthetic trailers pass while malformed status, message or details fields fail with no channel or service.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the trailer map and invoke no RPC.

new_proposals.title: XMP document-instance-original identifier lineage receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic XMP identifiers and history rows can require distinct document, instance and original identifiers plus monotonic unique event identifiers without claiming authenticity or provenance.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Required identifiers are absent or equal, a history event identifier repeats, parent linkage is self-referential, or the receipt is promoted to custody, authorship, title or authenticity evidence.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Distinct bounded identifiers and an acyclic local history pass; duplicates, self-links or authority claims fail.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the metadata and infer no provenance or ownership.

new_proposals.title: TTML time-expression frame-rate and region-reference receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic TTML timing metadata can validate closed clock-time and offset-time subsets against declared frame and tick rates and a known region set without rendering media.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Negative duration, unknown region, invalid frame or tick rate, out-of-range frame component, mixed unsupported syntax or a playback claim passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Bounded declared timing and region references pass; invalid rates, expressions and references fail without media or layout.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Refuse the cue descriptor and render nothing.

new_proposals.title: OpenTelemetry baggage member, property and transmission-budget tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic baggage members can enforce unique keys, bounded decoded values, closed property syntax and aggregate member and byte ceilings without propagating telemetry.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate or invalid keys, malformed percent escapes, control characters, excessive members or bytes pass, or propagation or observability completeness is claimed.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A bounded local member list passes; malformed, duplicate or excessive lists fail before serialization or propagation.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Drop the synthetic baggage and transmit nothing.

new_proposals.title: Authentication-Results authserv-id and method-result grammar receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic Authentication-Results descriptor can require a bounded authserv-id, registered-shape method names, closed result tokens and unique properties without authenticating mail.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A control-bearing authserv-id, unknown result, duplicate property, malformed method token or authentication claim passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: One bounded synthetic result passes and malformed or claim-promoting descriptors fail without a message or verifier.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the descriptor and authenticate no message.

new_proposals.title: MTA-STS mode, MX and max-age transition declaration
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic MTA-STS policy can enforce version, mode, MX-pattern and max-age shape plus an explicit testing-to-enforce transition hold without DNS or SMTP activity.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Unknown version or mode, invalid MX wildcard, Boolean or out-of-range max_age, direct none-to-enforce transition, or deployment claim passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A bounded testing policy and reviewed transition declaration pass; malformed or unsafe transitions fail with no DNS, SMTP or publication.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the previous synthetic mode and deploy nothing.

new_proposals.title: security.txt Contact, Expires and Canonical consistency receipt
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic security.txt field map can require at least one contact, one UTC expiry, HTTPS canonical locations and bounded preferred languages without publishing or retrieving a file.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Contact or expiry is absent, a web contact or canonical URI is non-HTTPS, expiry lacks UTC, languages are malformed, duplicate singletons pass, or vulnerability-handling authority is claimed.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A bounded synthetic field map passes and every missing, insecure or malformed declaration fails without retrieval, publication or disclosure action.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the field map and publish or contact nobody.

new_proposals.title: HTTP Problem Details core-member and extension-collision tribunal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic Problem Details object can validate bounded type, title, status, detail and instance members while refusing extension collisions and embedded secrets without serving HTTP.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Status is outside 100 through 599, type or instance URI is malformed, detail contains a secret marker, an extension collides case-insensitively with a core member, or service correctness is claimed.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: One bounded object passes and malformed, colliding or secret-bearing objects fail before serialization or response handling.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Replace the object with a local opaque refusal and send no response.

new_proposals.title: GMUT unimodular volume-form and integration-constant obligation board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed symbolic board can separate fixed-volume or Lagrange-multiplier formulations, trace-free equations, Bianchi identity, matter-conservation assumptions, cosmological integration constant, gauge scope, units, EFT domain and observation firewall.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Formulations are conflated, conservation is silently assumed, an integration constant is called a predicted cosmological constant, units or domains are absent, or symbolic rows are promoted to physics.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All declared formulations, assumptions, units, omitted terms and empirical gates remain explicit and promotion attempts fail.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the row to represented status and infer no physical result.

new_proposals.title: GMUT Z4c constraint-damping and characteristic-boundary obligation board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed symbolic board can distinguish Z4c constraint variables, damping parameters, characteristic speeds, gauge choices, boundary conditions, hyperbolicity assumptions, discretization dependencies, units, EFT scope and observation firewall.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Constraint damping is called a proof of stability, gauge or boundary conditions are omitted, BSSN and Z4c are conflated, numerical evidence is invented, or a physical prediction is claimed.
primary_source_needs: canonical GMUT stability and evidence boundary
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All variables, assumptions, gauges, boundaries and omitted numerical evidence remain explicit while promotion mutations fail.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep the board represented and claim no stability or simulation result.

new_proposals.title: THOS interlibrary-loan exception, privacy and handover proxy
new_proposals.hypothesis: Fictional request, patron-token, lender, item-condition, due-state, exception, correction, accessible-notice, queue-budget and next-owner fields can exercise a bounded handover state machine.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A direct patron identifier is required, an unresolved exception is released, correction lacks readback, queue budget is ignored, or the fixture is called real service or professional evidence.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Fictional transitions preserve privacy minimization, holds, correction lineage, workload ceilings and next-owner assignment; all real-service claims remain false.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Return the request to hold and infer no service or safety result.

new_proposals.title: Freed ID DANE TLSA usage-selector-matching and rollover reservation profile
new_proposals.hypothesis: Synthetic TLSA descriptors can separate usage, selector, matching type, association bytes, owner-name scope, DNSSEC dependency, rollover overlap, expiry, recovery and verifier policy without resolving DNS or validating a certificate.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Out-of-range fields pass, association length conflicts with matching type, DNSSEC dependency is omitted, rollover has no overlap, or the descriptor is called production identity or trust evidence.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: All structural fields and dependencies remain explicit; malformed and production-promoting fixtures fail without DNS, certificate or key operations.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the descriptor and perform no resolution or validation.

new_proposals.title: Gaia Focused Product Release zero-row schema and likelihood-refusal adapter
new_proposals.hypothesis: An official-source adapter contract can freeze product, table, release, calibration, selection, covariance, nuisance, checksum and likelihood duties while ingesting zero rows.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A query or download occurs, a real row or likelihood is processed, calibration or selection obligations are omitted, or readiness is called fit, constraint, prediction or confirmation.
primary_source_needs: official ESA Gaia Focused Product Release pages
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The contract contains zero real rows and zero likelihood evaluations and refuses every empirical conclusion until external evidence and review exist.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep transport disabled and retain the missing-data gap.

new_proposals.title: CBR interlibrary-loan access, privacy, remedy and Maori-authority matrix
new_proposals.hypothesis: A reservation matrix can make explicit that access, disability and language support, patron confidentiality, lending refusal, copyright and licensing, fees, loss or damage, remedy, data governance, cultural care and Maori authority require competent affected authorities.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Repository software recommends a real lending decision, disclosure, fee, remedy, legal interpretation, cultural disposition, Maori wording, data-governance outcome or affected-party acceptance.
primary_source_needs: tangata whenua, iwi, hapu and Maori-authority review where relevant
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Every real decision remains unmade and assigned to the appropriate external authority; any software-authored decision fails the matrix.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop, preserve the gate and seek exact competent and affected-party authority outside the repository.

boundary: This immutable x1 freeze is planning evidence only. It does not implement x2, close any gate, validate a final commit, deliver a baton or authorize Stage 20.
